| invariant (line) | check (smoke.mjs line) |
|---|---|
| Plan parity (17) | — no check named in the section |
| A zero-weight member costs nothing (28) | a folder keeps its slot across the membership toggle (3392) |
| No jump at the end of an animation (70) | — no check named in the section |
| Behaviour does not depend on how much was toggled (95) | — no check named in the section |
| The disc's density follows the notes on screen (101) | — no check named in the section |
| The hub stays the same share of the disc (179) | — no check named in the section |
| The camera reframes on a visibility toggle, but only while it wasn't already touched (202) | a range change animates instead of snapping (2257); a bar that loses its folder shrinks over the cascade instead of blinking out (4255) |
| Every note is filed exactly once, in either dimension (250) | — no check named in the section |
| The rings are independent (298) | — no check named in the section |
| Only depth-1 subfolders with their own tint slot are pushed (303) | — no check named in the section |
| A sub-wedge only earns its own slot if it can fill one (316) | no non-tail split cell holds fewer notes than its band's row depth (3282) |
| The resting disc is on the lattice (398) | — no check named in the section |
| Every heatmap day with notes fills its cell (417) | — no check named in the section |
| The heatmap band is painted for the state it landed in (431) | the heatmap band is painted for the state it landed in (246) |
| A heatmap day haloes and recolours, but never pushes (456) | — no check named in the section |
| `skipIndexation` is a promise, and only hlWalk can keep it (480) | — no check named in the section |
| A leaked Chrome on the debug port makes the suite measure a stale page (510) | — no check named in the section |
| Every highlight source belongs in the signature (533) | — no check named in the section |
| Aiming at a note is a timing problem before it is a geometry problem (546) | — no check named in the section |
| A sub-pixel dot is still a target (566) | a sub-pixel dot can still be hovered (1142) |
| Hover re-arms after the pointer leaves the stage (595) | hover re-arms after the pointer leaves the stage (1086); layout matches its golden snapshot (378) |
| The heatmap grid always fits its box (640) | — no check named in the section |
| The date strip is as wide as its slot, at every width (654) | the ribbon rescales with its slot (2929) |
| The intro sweeps the range end from one end of the strip to the other (687) | — no check named in the section |
| The window's travel is what the history exceeds the window by (716) | — no check named in the section |
| The window pill centres on the pointer's PIXEL, not its date (741) | — no check named in the section |
| The date axis weighs years by note count, not by calendar time (774) | compact axis: a year's width tracks its own note count (3020); compact axis: sparse years cluster near the same floor width (3059) |
| The strip's right edge is a day the vault has reached (868) | the ribbon's right edge is a day the vault has actually reached (3088) |
